# AMCP (Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy)

> > The Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy (AMCP) is the professional association for pharmacists and other healthcare practitioners working in managed care settings, advancing pharmacy practice, patient outcomes, and evidence-based care.

AMCP provides education, research, advocacy, and professional development for managed care pharmacy professionals. The organization offers volunteer programs like the Diplomat Program, educational webinars on topics such as health disparities and substance use disorder treatment, and partnerships with pharmacy schools for outcomes fellowships.

## Key Topics

- Managed care pharmacy
- Health disparities
- Substance use disorder treatment
- Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy
- Diplomat Program
- Access to care
- Outcomes research
- Schools of Pharmacy Relations Committee
- Western University of Health Sciences
- Volunteer programs
- Webinars and education
- Minority health
- Evidence-based practice

- [Western University - Outcomes Fellowship](https://www.amcp.org/western-university-outcomes-fellowship): Western University outcomes fellowship in health services research
